system.description:
Crossbow drill as taught in city militias, caravan guards and hold garrisons: one heavy bolt, aimed well.

  • Crossbow Drill: you are trained with all crossbows, and every Archer feature that names a bow works with a crossbow. You reload a heavy crossbow as part of the shot. A crossbow can't fire a Twin Nock; instead its one bolt deals an extra weapon damage die (two from 17th, in place of the third arrow).
    • 9th level: your Pinning Shot with a crossbow needs no wall: a Medium or smaller creature hit is pinned where it stands (Reflex save as normal).
  • Garrison Friend: Advantage on checks with city watches, militias, caravan masters and garrison quartermasters.
